notes: Born 1785, East Marlborough, Chester County, PA. Quaker convert. Father William Gause; mother Mary Beverly. First wife Martha Johnson (died 1828); second wife Minerva Eliza Byram (married 1830; refused Mormonism). Served briefly as JS Jr's counselor 1832, excommunicated 1832. Died c. 1836. Pennsylvania Quaker background - very disjoint from main cluster. Note: first wife Martha Johnson's connection to the Johnson family (apostle Luke Johnson) is unconfirmed and highly speculative.
